cohort: Pregnant women in their first trimester registered between June and August 2011 in a rural block primary health center in Assam, India.
finding: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus had significantly higher rates of caesarean section, higher birth weight infants, and more neonatal deaths.
followup_time: Through delivery and the postnatal period
birth_weight: Mean birth weight overall: 2.802 kg +/- 0.479 kg; higher among infants born to mothers with GDM
